name: Role-based sign-in opens the assigned portal
description: Checks that the backend-assigned role determines the portal after sign-in.
steps: Sign in with a manager account
Sign out and sign in with a student account
expected: Manager and student accounts open separate role-appropriate portals; users cannot select their own role.

name: Student manages personal event participation
description: Checks the main student participation workflow.
steps: Browse events and register a team
expected: The student can access their own participation information and requests, not global manager data.

name: Judge, mentor and volunteer portals remain restricted
steps: Sign in as a judge and inspect assigned work
Sign in as a mentor and inspect help requests
Sign in as a volunteer and validate a check-in code
expected: Each role sees only its permitted operational tools, and manager-only API actions remain protected.

name: Manager retains existing event operations
description: Checks that existing manager features remain available after adding role-based routing.
steps: Open Teams and generate match suggestions
Open Judging and inspect raw and calibrated rankings
expected: The manager workspace retains its existing operations and is not available to student accounts.
